content.value_statement: Marketing teams lose track of which claims have evidence and which offers are live. This skill creates one governed ledger for claim text, proof, disclaimers, expiry dates, and offer terms.
actual_capabilities: Records exact marketing claim text with evidence provenance and review dates.
Maintains live, upcoming, and ended offers with terms, codes, dates, and landing URLs.
Links claims to approved wording variants, disclaimers, policy flags, and usage locations.
Sweeps expired evidence and ended offers into open-loop tracking.
Resolves unresolved source flags from ad, landing page, brief, and content drafts.
limitations: Does not approve claims for launch or score paid media vetoes.
Does not replace legal review or regulatory counsel.
Requires user-provided evidence, documents, exports, or pasted copy.
Does not fetch platform data unless another connector or export is provided.

use_cases.title: Prepare ad claims for review
use_cases.description: Collect claim text, evidence source, disclaimers, and usage locations before paid media approval.

use_cases.title: Maintain substantiation records
use_cases.description: Keep a clear record of which claims are verified, user-attested, missing evidence, or expired.

use_cases.title: Coordinate live promotions
use_cases.description: Track offer terms, promo codes, dates, landing pages, and linked claims in one shared table.

prompt_templates.title: Register one claim
prompt_templates.prompt: Register this claim: "[exact claim text]". Evidence source: [document or user statement]. Used in: [asset or page].

prompt_templates.title: Log current offers
prompt_templates.prompt: Log our current offers from this promo calendar. Include terms, codes, start dates, end dates, landing URLs, and status.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve source gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these ad and landing page drafts. Extract claims, resolve source gaps where evidence is provided, and flag missing proof.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh the registry
prompt_templates.prompt: Sweep the claims ledger and offers table. Expire outdated rows, update open loops, and prepare a handoff for the next review skill.

output_examples.input: A pasted ad draft with two performance claims and one missing source flag.
output_examples.output: The response registers each claim, labels evidence provenance, notes missing proof, and lists the affected ad assets.

output_examples.input: A promotion calendar with codes, dates, and landing page URLs.
output_examples.output: The response updates offer status, links offers to related claims, and marks ended promotions for follow-up.

output_examples.input: A request to check whether a claim is approved for launch.
output_examples.output: The response returns ledger facts and routes launch approval to the appropriate audit skill.

best_practices: Paste exact claim wording instead of summaries or paraphrases.
Include evidence source names, dates, and usage locations whenever available.
Run a sweep before major launches or after promotion end dates.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a registered claim as approved for launch.
Do not invent evidence sources or upgrade provenance labels without user input.
Do not store sponsorship disclosure rules as claim-level disclaimers.

faq.question: What does this skill store?
faq.answer: It stores claim text, evidence provenance, approved wording, disclaimers, usage locations, review dates, and live offer terms.

faq.question: Can it approve an ad claim?
faq.answer: No. It records the facts that audit skills use when they decide whether a claim can ship.

faq.question: What evidence does it need?
faq.answer: It needs user-provided documents, named studies, internal reports, offer calendars, exports, or clear user attestations.

faq.question: Can it handle expired offers?
faq.answer: Yes. It can mark ended offers, link affected claims, and move unresolved work to open loops.

faq.question: Does it use external APIs?
faq.answer: No API is required. It works from pasted text, documents, calendars, or exports supplied by the user.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it when marketing, content, compliance, or paid media teams need one trusted record for claim substantiation.
